text:
tess: EdgeFlux reported unexpected invoice line items after we rolled their aggregator. Looks like minute->hour translation plus SKU aliasing. Quick sync?

omar: Short repro: aggregator emits per-minute "counts" in local tz; adapter assumed UTC and also maps alias 'flux-core' -> 'edgeflux-core-hour' without multiplier. Net effect: some hours double-counted at DST boundary.

maria: Fix plan (minimal): 1) normalize incoming minute_start to UTC on ingest; 2) require usage_key = sha256(partner+device+minute_epoch) for dedupe; 3) adaptor emit qty in hours (minute=0.01666667) with 8-decimal string; 4) keep alias map with explicit multiplier.

tess: Reconcile plan: daily compare partner-minute-agg -> invoice-hours, if delta <=0.75% auto-adjust, 0.75%-3% billing review, >3% escalate. Backfill path: partner will drop 14d minute-archives S3. We'll dry-run on 3 pilot accounts first.

omar: Sample minimal payload we'll accept: {"usage_key":"sha256(...)","sku":"edgeflux-core-hour","qty":"0.01666667","window_start":"2026-05-03T10:00:00Z"} — sign with X-Partner-Sig.

maria: Action items: tess create partner note & schedule sync (ETA 24h), omar adapter changes + alias map (48h), maria backfill runner dry-run (72h). billing-bot: create ticket PART-EDGEFLUX-221.

edgeflux-bot: Uploaded sample archive s3://edgeflux-archive/partnerships/minute-agg/2026-05-*.json

tess: I'll host partner call tomorrow 9am PT. Please bring schema, dry-run plan, and the customer-facing note draft.

omar: Will have adapter PR ready for review.

maria: Will run dry-run on staging and post diff CSV to the ticket.

tess: Thanks all. We'll keep customer comms transparent and aim to correct any overcharges on next billing cycle.
